bible.title: The Birch Singer
bible.kernel: A temple priest hires the company to fetch a caged singer whose songs start riots, and the company must retrieve him from a fringe worshipper's hold and deliver him to the temple.

cast.name: Roldofin Leafshade
cast.who: A temple priest at the Silverbough Reliquary who guards a birch votive.
cast.want: to recover the temple's caged singer and deliver them to temple custody

cast.name: Llevas Ashveil
cast.who: An elf captured for his songs, once a shrine performer from the Western Forests.
cast.want: to avoid being returned to temple custody

cast.name: Faendal
cast.who: A charismatic lay worshipper who leads a fringe birch-cult in the Western Forests.
cast.want: to keep the singer for public songs that stir his followers

bible.situation: Roldofin hires the company to fetch a singer whose songs start riots and to return him to temple custody. The singer exists and has been held in cages that move between small shrine outposts and private holds. Fringe worshippers value the singer as a means to rally quarrels among forest folk, and those worshippers conceal him and trade tokens among allies. The company has a clear fee and an explicit delivery requirement to hand the singer back to Roldofin.
bible.goal: to recover the temple's caged singer and deliver them to temple custody
arc: Travel to the Birchward Clearing that Roldofin named to inspect the temple's holding cage → yields: a birch-tagged note signed Faendal pointing to Garanth Hollow
Use Faendal's note to find Garanth Hollow and confront the cult there → yields: Faendal refuses and flees, dropping a copper sigil stamped with a moss-keeper's mark
Trace the sigil to Mossward Nook and bargain with the keeper for access → yields: an iron key stamped with the Silverbough Reliquary's mark and the news that Llevas now waits at the Reliquary
Go to the Silverbough Reliquary, use the key to open the cage, and deliver Llevas to Roldofin while Faendal returns to block the handover. Overcome Faendal and complete the delivery
tensions: Faendal's followers will rally at any public singing and drag crowds into quarrel.
Local keepers fear the singer's effect and will only bargain for heavy prices or favors.
The temple demands sighted delivery and will not accept a substitute or payment in place of the singer.
openDirections: The birch-cult grows bolder and may press the temple for a public performance that could spill beyond the groves.
bible.stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the temple's birch pillar will be torn down when the singer's songs incite a mob, ending the temple's claim over the grove.
bible.arrival: crossed the river to get here · refused food and drink

shipped.title: Inspect the holding cage at Birchward Clearing
shipped.situation: A priest, Roldofin Leafshade, crossed the river to the fort and refused food and drink. He rubs a thumb along a scar as he says the place to check is the Birchward Clearing. He wants you to travel there to inspect the temple's holding cage and coin when it is done, and anything carried home. He asks you to confirm the singer is still caged rather than released to the grove. A fringe worshipper means to keep the singer for public songs and will try to stop anyone who moves the captive. "If the company fails, the temple's birch pillar will be torn down when the singer's songs incite a mob, ending the temple's claim over the grove," he warns.
shipped.job: Travel to the Birchward Clearing to inspect the temple's holding cage
